_purpose: Validates that O1 override (G01 + G02) forces band to Distress when pre-override score would have been Watchlist. Without this test, a broken O1 implementation could pass all real-company fixtures (Braskem scores 100 even without override).

G01_negative_equity._note: Mild negative equity — just tipped below zero

G02_going_concern.emphasis_topics: Negative equity position and uncertainty regarding refinancing

G04_distributing_while_insolvent.reason_not_fired: No dividends declared during analysis window

G05_financing_dependence_for_payouts.reason_not_fired: No dividends paid; no payout dependence to test

G06_technical_insolvency_trajectory.reason_not_fired: 3 declining periods but window only covers the decline; opening-to-closing ratio does not cross 50% threshold within the ≥3 period window definition

_expected_math.fundamentals: profitability 5 (8% EBIT in 0-10 band) + cash_gen 0 (FCF positive) + leverage 0 (2x below half of 5x default threshold = 2.5x) + liquidity 3 (ratio 1.20 in 1.0-1.5 band) = 8
_expected_math.override: O1 fires (G01 + G02) — score forced to max(58, 80) = 80, band forced to Distress
